rules.name: Meter Reading Monotonicity
rules.description: Current meter reading must be greater than or equal to previous reading.
rules.recommendation: Reject readings smaller than previous billing cycle unless meter reset is authenticated.

rules.name: Bill Calculation Due Date
rules.description: Ensure penalty/late fees are strictly computed only after payment due date passes.
rules.recommendation: Check invoice dueDate against current payment timestamp using UTC/Dhaka timezone.
